title: Advance to the next column
statement: Let $x$ be a bit string and $v$ a register assignment with every register at most $4(|x|+1)$. If $v(12)\le v(1)$ and $v(7)+1\le 4(|x|+1)$, then from the carry-halving state the fixed multiplication program reaches the column state with registers $11$, $7$, and $12$ replaced respectively by $\lfloor v(11)/2\rfloor$, $v(7)+1$, and $\min(v(12)+1,v(1))$; all other registers are unchanged, and no answer is recorded. Every earlier configuration satisfies the program's instruction side conditions and register bound.
